system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Updates the bank account details linked to the farmer's PM-KISAN account. For your information, my bank_account_number is None, my ifsc_code is None, my aadhaar_number is 100020004730.

function.name: pmkisan_update_bank_details
function.description: Updates the bank account details linked to the farmer's PM-KISAN account. Aadhaar-bank linkage is required — payments fail if Aadhaar is not linked to a valid bank account. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT verify whether payments have resumed after the update — use pmkisan_track_payment for that. Fails if the bank account number or IFSC code is invalid, or if the account does not belong to the Aadhaar holder.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

bank_account_number.description: New bank account number for receiving DBT payments.

ifsc_code.description: IFSC code of the new bank branch.
